headline: ASX Healthcare Sector Continues Gains as Neuren Surges and CSL Cools
summary: The Australian healthcare stock index extended its gains following a 6.32% surge in October, driven by strong buying in Neuren Pharmaceuticals while market giant CSL saw trading cool.
why: Healthcare represents a defensive sector within the Australian equity market, with major global biotechnology exporters.

impacts.name: S&P/ASX 200
impacts.why: Outperformance in biotechnology shares provided sector-level support to the Australian equity market.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Continued capital inflows into domestic biotechnology firms sustained performance for Australian healthcare equities.
